name: arcane
description: Modern Docker Management, Designed for Everyone
one_liner: A clean dashboard for managing Docker containers on your server without typing terminal commands.
buyer: A small agency or solo developer who self-hosts client apps on a VPS and wants a friendly way to manage containers without a DevOps hire.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer uses it to manage containers for 10 small-business client sites on one shared VPS.
A self-hosting enthusiast community recommends it as the easy on-ramp to running their own services (replacing paid cloud hosting).
An agency offers 'managed self-hosting' to clients who don't want AWS bills, using Arcane as the day-to-day control panel.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a 'managed Docker hosting' service for small businesses built on top of Arcane, charging monthly for server + dashboard access.
Sell a paid setup/onboarding package that migrates a client's existing services into an Arcane-managed VPS.

steal_this: Spin up a cheap VPS, install Arcane, and offer 'we'll self-host your small business app for $15/month, cheaper than Heroku' to a few local businesses this weekend.
